topic: Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeats GOP incumbent in North Carolina House race
title: Democrat Chuck Hubbard Wins North Carolina House Race After Recount
dek: Chuck Hubbard defeated long-serving Republican incumbent Virginia Foxx in a close North Carolina House contest that required an official recount.
body:
Democrat Chuck Hubbard won the North Carolina House race against Republican incumbent Virginia Foxx after an official recount. The contest remained tight until the final count confirmed Hubbard's victory. Foxx had served as a Republican representative for many years before this outcome.

The result forms part of Democratic gains in the House during the 2026 election year. It adds to the party's majority margins and contributes to a broader shift reported across several races. Turnout levels and district-specific dynamics helped shape the final numbers.

## National implications
The win carries effects beyond the district. Shifts in committee power at the national level are expected as a result. The race also drew attention to key local and national issues that influenced voter decisions.

Some reports place the outcome among record margins for the cycle. The narrow margin that triggered the recount highlights how small differences in participation can alter representation. Hubbard's victory stands as one piece of the wider changes in House composition.
